question: Who among the following is credited with patenting the FM radio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Edwin H Armstrong**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Edwin H Armstrong is an American inventor who developed the **modern radio and electronic circuitry**.
 
• He was an **electrical engineer** also known as the father of** FM radio.**
 
• He patented **FM radio in 1933**.
 
• He has won many awards such as the** IEEE Medal of Honor (1917), Holley Medal (1940), Franklin Medal (1941), IEEE Edison Medal (1942) and Washington Award (1951)**.
